summary: Implemented the Tabs widget feature without running anything (read/edit only, nothing committed). Changed: src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py (clickable_ranges input before width; yields one Text with click spans last; early path background-only), src/textual/renderables/opacity.py (blend color merged into existing style so meta survives), tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (three tests appended, existing unchanged). Added: src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; __all__ = Tab, Tabs; DEFAULT_STYLES "height: 2;"), tests/test_tabs.py, docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css. Layout resolver unchanged because its Edge protocol already has size, fraction, and min_size. Deviations: bar position uses the displayed-tab index, not the full-list index, so duplicate names still underline the correct tab; Escape calls app.set_focus(None) unawaited because App has no focus method. Unverified risk: Tabs' prevent_default may stop the App's on_key from dispatching for keys Tabs handles; needs a runtime check. Next step: run pytest tests/test_tabs.py tests/renderables.
